wins: Identified high-value open TCP/UDP ports during initial scanning phase, acquiring actionable reconnaissance data for future exploitation attempts.
Successfully mapped internal network topology through automated discovery tools, yielding precise host/service relationships despite no final compromise.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges on the target due to lack of validated exploit chains for the identified services, resulting in 0% success rate.
Multiple credential spraying attempts were rate-limited and blocked by basic account lockout defenses, preventing further lateral movement.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was strong, but exploitation efforts stalled because privilege escalation and credential reuse paths were not validated; focus should shift to exploiting identified services with validated payloads.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts against discovered Linux hosts repeatedly failed because the chosen exploit (CVE template) did not match the kernel/service version.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When service ports respond with banners
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted version detection using nmap -sV with service fingerprinting
Attempt credential reuse with Hydra against SSH and SMB services with low-speed rate limits

memory_ops.reason: High leverage in reconnaissance phase and consistent banner capture

next_experiments.title: Validate Privilege Escalation Chain for SSH Service
next_experiments.description: Use detailed version data from nmap -sV to select and execute matching exploit modules (e.g., CVE-2024-XXXXX) or manual post-auth enumeration via ssh-shell

next_experiments.title: Credential Spraying with Account Lockout Mitigation
next_experiments.description: Implement slower, randomized Hydra tries across SSH/SMB with proxying to avoid lockouts, focusing on verified users with MFA bypass filing after each low-rate attempt

next_experiments.title: Automated Exploit Chain Validation
next_experiments.description: Develop scripted workflow (Metasploit or custom) that chains initial shell (ssh/ftp) to local escalation checks (e.g., LinPEAS/LinEnum) to confirm exploit viability before final execution
